_usage: Throughput-first defaults: plain_only=true (one .log per worker, no .json.log), 4MiB rotation, emit_chunk 512, 280k lines/s — avoids 8KiB×2-files rollover thrash that capped ~14k/s. high-compression case overrides to JSON + smaller rotation for compression stress.

benchmarks.name: profile-high-throughput
benchmarks.description: Set agent logs_config.profile to high-throughput. Uses defaults (plain-only, fast rotation size).

benchmarks.name: profile-high-compression
benchmarks.description: JSON + plain, heavier multiline/wide, 256KiB rotation — stresses compression path; slower aggregate lines/s than other cases.
